title: CWP/11581/2025 of SUBHASH CHANDER BENIWAL AND OTHERS Vs STATE OF HARYANA AND OTHERS
judge: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE VINOD S. BHARDWAJ
text: 11 IN THE HIGH COURT OF PUNJAB & HARYANA AT CHANDIGARH 120 Date of decision: 28.04.2025 Subhash Chander Beniwal and others ...Petitioners VERSUS State of Haryana and others ...Respondents CORAM : HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE VINOD S. BHARDWAJ Present :- Mr. Sandeep Thakan, Advocate for the petitioner(s). Ms. Tanisha Peshawaria, DAG Haryana. VINOD S. BHARDWAJ, J. (Oral) The instant petition has been filed for issuance of directions to the respondent-Department to grant/release 2nd A.C.P. and 3rd A.C.P. scales alongwith consequential benefits to the petitioners as they have rendered statutory period of service of 20/30 years. At the very outset, learned counsel for the petitioners contends that the issue involved in the present case is covered by the judgment dated 24.07.2015 passed by this Court in CWP-23074-2010 titled as ‘Ram Pal Patwari and others Vs. State of Haryana and another’ and other connected cases. Learned State counsel does not dispute the aforesaid factual position. The present petition is disposed of in terms of the order dated 24.07.2015 passed by this Court in the matter of Ram Pal Patwari and others (Supra). (VINOD S. BHARDWAJ) 28.04.2025 JUDGE Mangal Singh
